change: Owned snapshot scope-change detection and one-shot agent recovery
behavior: Same owner with changed schema/column grants gets 409 SNAPSHOT_SCOPE_CHANGED before rows or presigned URLs
Backend retains original SQL in private metadata and revalidates it through normal query guards on owned POST /snapshots/{id}/rebuild
Agent forces catalog refresh once and attempts one rebuild
Successful recovery returns 409 SNAPSHOT_REPLACED, replacement metadata and reset_table=true; no automatic old-offset replay
Rebuild errors retain backend status/code and Retry-After with reset_table=true

validation.scope: Fake stores/query streams and mock HTTP transport; no new live infrastructure run. Private accrual YAML excluded only in release copy.

consumer_work_remaining: Ember must consume SNAPSHOT_REPLACED, clear old rows, persist new reference and reload at offset zero. Clear rows on reset_table even when recovery fails.
limitations: No detection of upstream permission changes until session grants reflect them
Issued S3 links retain signed lifetime
Query identity changes still return 404; only grants changes are automatically recovered
git: No commit or push; private accrual content and existing index preserved
